summary: Thin-wrapper redesign: nextcloudcmd now owns synchronization, conflict resolution, and safety; the app is a GNOME companion around it.
changelog: Removed the protected-initialization subsystem (bootstrap staging, safety baseline, run markers, deletion guard, and the review window). The first sync is now a single nextcloudcmd run with delta detection; config schema bumps from v4 to v5 and drops the safety fields automatically.
Leftover protected-* staging trees are removed and legacy safety manifests are archived on first run after upgrade.

Added a first-sync confirmation dialog before the initial run when the local folder, the remote folder, or both are empty (the remote side is probed with a shallow WebDAV PROPFIND that downloads no bodies).
Added a conflicted-copy resolver window that lists the files nextcloudcmd preserves as '* (Nextcloud conflicted copy <date>).*' with Keep Local, Keep Remote, and Open in Files actions.

Surfaced real nextcloudcmd per-file progress (current file and processed count) in the account view and the tray tooltip during a sync, with a fallback to the existing state label when the engine emits no per-file output.
